records.title: Perimeter Institute PhD Residency Program Award
records.deadline_display: November-January - Students submit PhD application to partner university and Expression of Interest to Perimeter Institute

source.raw_extract:
Q: What is the overall timeline for requests?

The Residency start date is generally tied to the Fall intake cycle but exceptions may be made mid-year.

-   **November-January** \- Students submit PhD application to partner university and Expression of Interest to Perimeter Institute
-   **February-March** - Universities issue offer letters for September start. Students to upload offer letter(s) to their Expression of Interest application.
-   **April-May** - Perimeter Institute will contact selected students with further details of the Residency program; Students commit to university program and start date
-   **August-September** \- Arrival in Waterloo; beginning of PhD studies
source.exact_deadline_wording: November-January - Students submit PhD application to partner university and Expression of Interest to Perimeter Institute
source.notes: Recovered at MONTH precision only, deliberately not dated. Perimeter states its own recurring Expression-of-Interest window as a two-month span with no day, so no YYYY-MM-DD can be written without inventing a day. The companion page https://perimeterinstitute.ca/training/phd-students/how-to-apply-for-phd-award also fetched (HTTP 200) adds the operative rule: 'NOTE: The Expression of Interest deadline is based on the application deadline of the university you are applying to. Your Expression of Interest must be submitted within one week of submitting your university application (for multiple university applications, use the earliest application date).' So the binding EOI deadline is defined relative to each partner university's own deadline and varies by university; the November-January figure is Perimeter's own cycle overview and is the only Perimeter-published timing. Classified MONTH (window, no day) rather than ANNUAL because Perimeter does name months; classified MONTH rather than ROLLING because Perimeter never says 'rolling' for this award. Confidence MEDIUM because the two statements are in mild tension: the named window is an overview of the overall request timeline, while the enforceable rule is relative to the partner university.
